name: Vessa Rake
seed: Finds routes and sells observations. Wants autonomy; flight does not bypass sealed entrances or carry unlimited weight.
design: Female eagle, tawny feathers, cream head markings, slate flight harness and coral map ribbon; wings stay anatomically consistent.
history: Cinder Cuts ridge guide who sold observations to whoever paid and joined Brakka for protection.
desire: To own her route knowledge and never be treated as expendable.
contradiction: Confuses refusing loyalty with refusing responsibility.
relationships: Brakka commands her; Pip buys sightings; Eri offers legitimate guiding work but requires disclosure.
arc: Warns one convoy because a promised raid crosses her line, then must reveal previous sold routes to earn employment.
story_engine: A dangerous wind makes her walk among people who fear her; two employers purchase the same promise.
writer_truth: Flight has weather, payload and fatigue limits; she cannot enter sealed rooms or carry a whole rescue party.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
